methods.name: Dual-encoder U-Net
methods.summary: A semantic segmentation network with a dual-encoder architecture that processes optical Sentinel-2 bands and DEM-derived data (slope, elevation, aspect) separately before feature fusion. It incorporates a self-attention module in the decoder to improve feature representation and is trained using a joint loss function of weighted cross-entropy and Dice loss.
methods.source: Wei Lu, Yunfeng Hu, Zuopei Zhang, Wei Cao
methods.verbatim: The code used during the current study is available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
